new_statement: The bound is derived directly from the root hypotheses, without node 1.2. For every matrix level m and z in M_m(B), complete positivity and unitality of Delta_m give the Schwarz inequality Delta_m(z)^*Delta_m(z)<=Delta_m(z^*z): apply the positive map id_2 tensor Delta_m to the positive block [[z^*z,z^*],[z,1]]. Since 0<=z^*z<=||z||^2 1, positivity and unitality then give ||Delta_m(z)||<=||z||; hence ||Delta||_cb<=1. At each matrix level, Phi Delta-Delta=(Phi-Delta Upsilon)Delta+Delta(Upsilon Delta-I_B), so the two root cb bounds imply ||Phi Delta-Delta||_cb<=epsilon+epsilon=2*epsilon. Finally Phi=JQD and DJ=I give D Phi=Q D, whence QA-A=D(Phi Delta-Delta)iota. Diagonal extraction D is contractive and the unital *-isomorphism iota is isometric, so ||QA-A||_{inf->inf}<=2*epsilon.
